title: Grateful Dead Live at Family Dog at the Great Highway on 1969-08-30
venue: Family Dog at the Great Highway
source: Master Soundboard Reel > Cass > DAT > CD; via Seth Kaplan; Seeded to etree by Steve Barbella - Patched and Tagged by Kevin Tobin

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of an all‑time great performance highlighted by a stellar Dark Star and superb Morning Dew.
ai_review.review: The reviewer raves about the recording, calling it “awesome” and noting that the entire concert is amazing, with particular praise for a “really great Dark Star” and a very strong Morning Dew. No technical flaws are mentioned, suggesting a clear, well‑mixed soundboard source. Overall sentiment is highly positive, indicating this show stands out as a memorable Dead experience.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review praises both the performance and recording without any criticism; weighting favors the show (70%) but limited data reduces confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes the recording as awesome with no noted issues, implying clear and well‑balanced sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The entire show is described as amazing, suggesting a consistently high‑energy set with no weak moments mentioned.
